requirements.quote: Students are expected to have taken the following courses prior to entering the CBB program: Mathematics through at least differential equations and linear algebra A course in probability and at least one other course in statistics Courses in programming, data structures, and algorithms
We encourage applications from students with strong undergraduate backgrounds in biology, statistics, mathematics, physics, and/or computer science.

problems: cbb.duke.edu is UNREACHABLE via the project fetcher (host/TLS/proxy error); prerequisites taken from the CBB pages on medschool.duke.edu.

The 'Prerequisites' list (which also includes genetics, cell/molecular biology, and biochemistry or organic chemistry) is followed by: 'Otherwise competitive students lacking one or more of these requirements will be expected to satisfy these prerequisites prior to or during their first year.' So they are expected/required but can be remediated after admission.
'Mathematics through at least differential equations' recorded as calculus + differential_equations; multivariable calculus is not named explicitly.
